record.Description: This recall involves Harkla’s children’s sensory swings. The compression swings have a blue fabric seat and come with a four-hole hook and ceiling mounting hardware for suspension, with a drop length of 18 to 24 inches. Only swings with a four-hole hook are included in this recall. SKU number LS-COMP-1BLU or LS-COMP-1BLU-SW is printed on the side of the product packaging.
record.Title: Harkla Recalls Children’s Sensory Swings Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fall Hazard
record.ConsumerContact: Harkla toll-free at 844-442-7552 from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. PT Monday through Friday, by email at recall@harkla.co or online at https://harkla.co/pages/ceiling-hook-recall-2026 or https://harkla.co and click “Recall” at the top of the page.

Products.Name: Harkla Sensory Swings
Products.NumberOfUnits: About 25,541 (In addition, about 5,534 were sold in Canada)

Images.Caption: Recalled Harkla Children’s Compression Sensory Swing
Four-hole ceiling hook mounting plate that came with the recalled Harkla sensory swing.

Injuries.Name: Harkla has received 29 reports of the swing’s ceiling hook separating, including 14 injuries that resulted in two concussions, a broken arm, bumps and bruises.

Hazards.Name: The recalled swings’ ceiling hook can separate from its plate, posing a risk of serious injury from a fall hazard.
